name: labs/dgretton__pyhamilton
title: Hamilton liquid handler (pyhamilton.HamiltonInterface)
intro: Hamilton liquid handler (pyhamilton.HamiltonInterface), adapted from dgretton/pyhamilton. It reads `is_open` and `server_exited`; runs `initialize`, `aspirate`, `dispense`, `move_plate` and 3 more. `initialize`: initialize the Hamilton robot (the upstream INITIALIZE command) and wait for its response. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/dgretton__pyhamilton --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/dgretton__pyhamilton --backend fake --mcp
